Test cases for Format of lists.
-- tight_item_with_sublist --
 3. Item text introducing a nested list,
    wrapped onto a second line:
      - first child,
      - second child.
-- tight_deep_sublists --
  - Fixed issues in this area,
    wrapped onto a second line:
      - first fix here,
      - second fix here.
-- loose_item_with_sublist --
  - Item text introducing a nested list,
    wrapped onto a second line:

      - first child,
      - second child.
-- ordered_sublist_not_starting_at_one --
  - Item text introducing an ordered list,
    wrapped onto a second line:

     2. second point.
-- tight_sublists_inside_loose_list --
  - First item of a loose list,
    wrapped onto a second line.

  - Build system
      - ESBuild
          - primary choice for new projects

  - Last item here.
-- want --
  - First item of a loose list,
    wrapped onto a second line.

  - Build system

      - ESBuild
          - primary choice for new projects

  - Last item here.
-- fence_tight_in_loose_item --
  - First item of a loose list.

  - Steps to follow:
    ```
    run this
    ```

  - Last item here.
-- want --
  - First item of a loose list.

  - Steps to follow:

    ```
    run this
    ```

  - Last item here.
-- wide_ordered_marker_with_fence --
10. Set the fixed IP address
    - uncomment the block in the config
    ```
    interface eth0
    ```
    where XXX marks the last octet
-- want --
 10. Set the fixed IP address
       - uncomment the block in the config
     ```
     interface eth0
     ```
     where XXX marks the last octet
-- indented_code_after_list --
  2. You may modify your copy and
distribute such modifications under
these conditions:

    a) You must cause the modified files
    b) You must keep the notices intact
-- want --
 2. You may modify your copy and
    distribute such modifications under
    these conditions:

```
a) You must cause the modified files
b) You must keep the notices intact
```
